newsitem.title: USA: ORBCOMM says in Korean licensing pact.
newsitem.headline: ORBCOMM says in Korean licensing pact.

text.p: Satellite-based communications system operator ORBCOMM Global LP said on Wednesday it had signed a service license agreement with Communications Technology Inc (CTI) of Seoul, Korea.
To manage the venture, ORBCOMM said, CTI has established ORBCOMM Korea, through which it will provide ORBCOMM communication services to South Korea.

In addition, CTI has also signed a memorandum of understanding with ORBCOMM to explore the development and manufacture by CTI of ORBCOMM Subscriber Communicators for distribution worldwide, ORBCOMM said.
It said that the addition of Korea as a network partner brings the total number of countries to be serviced by the ORBCOMM system to 70.
CTI is engaged in the manufacture, supply and integration of next-generation technologies for the information super highway.
ORBCOMM is a mobile satellite service provider offering low-cost, two-way message and data communications globally through service licensees and value-added resellers.

ORBCOMM launched the first two satellites in April 1995, which are provideing initial commercial two-way communications and position determination services. A constellation of 28 satellites is planned to enable users all over the world to send and receive short messages at low costs, it said.
ORBCOMM is a venture of Orbital Sciences Corp, Canada's Teleglobe Inc and Malaysia's Technology Resources Industries Berhad.
